collection.title: Ferrari 812 Superfast 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ferrari 812 Superfast 2017 onwards version uses a 28" wiper blade on drivers side and a 17" wiper blade on the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
